record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, double the effective nonpadding embedding row norm from sqrt(2*d/(itemnum+2+d)) to twice that value, consistently for context lookup, masked-item logits and candidate scoring. Retain tied embeddings, width 64, zero padding and the exclusive mask ID. Stronger item vectors may improve content discrimination relative to positional embeddings while increasing logit separation. Keep features, topology, history, loss and optimizer fixed; use the same normalization in the generated predictor.

category_rationales.rationale: Double the fixed nonpadding embedding row norm across all four category models to strengthen item representations relative to positional embeddings. The shared effective table applies consistently to context lookup, masked-item logits and candidate scoring. Preserve tied embeddings, width, zero padding, exclusive mask ID, topology, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, keeping inference consistent without checkpoint shape changes.
